commit_before_run: this file + selected checkpoint SHA256 + OFFLINE_GATE selection.json must be committed before any P5 rollout

seeds.rule: never collected as demonstrations, never used for checkpoint selection

arms.policy: pairact-r1 checkpoint chosen by harness.pairact_r1.select_checkpoint on validation
arms.inputs: own RGB 4 lags, own 16 issued commands, task tokens, own v7 clocks (deadband 2)
arms.forbidden: teacher, GT pose, partner pose, stage or geometry inputs; any GT/teacher correction of student commands

arms.policy: P2 MJWarp GT pair-carry teacher (same source SHA as P3 collection)
arms.note: GT allowed; reported side by side as the reference, not as a learned result

start_distribution: same generator as P3: each robot 0.3-1.2 m from its assigned beam end

episode_cap_sim_s.value: [미정: 아래 규칙으로 P2 teacher smoke 결과에서 계산해 P5 실행 전 커밋]
episode_cap_sim_s.rule: cap = 60 (grasp cap, P1 gate와 같음) + carry_budget. carry_budget = ceil10(1.5 x max_k carry_s[k]) + 3.0 (release_instruction_after_s) + 1.5 (finish_after_s), 상한 120 s(runner carry cap 최대). carry_s[k] = P2 teacher smoke world k의 result.json carry.events에서 handover 시각부터 'done' 단계 진입 시각까지의 SIM s(교사 command_sequence_complete인 world만). ceil10은 10 s 단위 올림.
episode_cap_sim_s.inputs: P2 smoke (dsh/pairact-p2-carrypath-r SMOKE.md, world 1·11·17) summary.json + world-00k/raw/result.json(.zst)
episode_cap_sim_s.if_no_complete_carry: smoke에서 command_sequence_complete world가 0이면 cap을 정하지 않고 P5를 시작하지 않는다(보고 후 결정)
episode_cap_sim_s.if_timeout: 어느 smoke world라도 carry_total_timeout이면 carry_budget = 120으로 두고 그 사실을 기록한다
episode_cap_sim_s.why_max_and_1_5: n=3이라 분포 꼬리를 추정할 수 없으므로 최댓값에 1.5배 여유를 둔다. 학생은 교사보다 느릴 수 있고(재시도·정지), cap이 짧으면 cap_end가 성공을 가린다
episode_cap_sim_s.same_for_both_arms: 학생과 teacher arm 모두 같은 cap을 쓴다

success.definition: placed_in_zone_B AND drop_events == 0 AND robot_robot_contacts == 0 (harness/pair_carry_eval.py, GT evaluator only)

definitions.approach: both robots within the registered grasp-approach radius of their assigned ends (beamact4 funnel)
definitions.alignment: both robots pass the nominal alignment check (beamact4 funnel)
definitions.READY: both own learned stage heads declared READY and pinned GO/ACK issued
definitions.grasp: both grippers closed on the beam (beamact4 funnel grasp)
definitions.hold_3s: joint lift held 3 s (P1 gate criterion)
definitions.carry_1m: beam centre moved >= 1.0 m from its post-hold position without a drop event
definitions.door: beam centre passed the door plane (P2 evaluator door_t not None)

funnel.report: count reaching each stage, n/20 per arm, same seed order

report.primary: student n/20 and teacher n/20 on the same 20 heldout seeds

exclusions.pre_run_static_check: only the pre-registered P0 static stance-feasibility check (world-37 type), applied to all 20 seeds before any rollout; excluded seeds listed here before the run
exclusions.host_error: one rerun of the same seed; a second HOST_ERROR counts as failure and is reported separately

minimum_success_claim: >= 1/20 student success meets the r1 minimum; 0/20 is reported with the funnel as the result

student_runtime_wiring.worker: dsh/pairact-p5-student scripts/pairact_r1_student_worker.py (isolated actor process, own camera + own issued command in, commands out)
student_runtime_wiring.release_instruction: both robots' own grasp done flags continuously true for 3.0 SIM s -> skill release, destination B (no GT/teacher)
student_runtime_wiring.finish: both robots' own release done flags continuously true for 1.5 SIM s, or the cap
student_runtime_wiring.setdown_boundary_for_drop: evaluator counts carry_low only before the first row whose GT beam footprint is inside zone B (student has no teacher lower-start time); tilt/fall drops apply to the whole episode
